# routeros_interface_pptp_server (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_pptp_server" "server" {
  name     = "example"
  comment  = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `user` (String) The name of the PPP user the interface is bound to.

### Read-Only

- `client_address` (String) The IP address of the currently connected client.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `encoding` (String) Encryption and encoding used by the active session.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mru` (Number) Maximum Receive Unit negotiated for the active session.
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum Transmission Unit negotiated for the active session.
- `running` (Boolean)
- `uptime` (String) Duration of the active session.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/interface/pptp-server get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_interface_pptp_server.server "*1"
```
